//: Copy to appsettings.local.json (gitignored, loaded last). In a container set the same keys as env vars instead (e.g. Myss_AllowMockAuth).
//mock-auth: Fail-closed dev sign-in (no real Keycloak needed). ALL THREE keys are required; any unset value disables it, and a prod-named EnvironmentName with these set makes the app refuse to start. Env vars: Myss_AllowMockAuth, Myss_EnvironmentName, Myss_MockAuth.
//MockAuthPersona: admin | worker | workernoidir | alice | bob | carol | bceid | bcsc (the same personas as MyssApi's). Override per request with the X-Mock-Persona header. Only admin and worker carry an IDIR identity; admin opens the form editor and the review screens, worker the review screens.
//Strapi: The write-scoped token from Strapi's admin panel (Settings > API Tokens). Env var: Myss_Strapi__AdminApiToken.
//Cdogs: Credentials for the bus pass PDF (CDOGS). Env vars: Myss_Cdogs__ClientId / Myss_Cdogs__ClientSecret.
